remarks: Wellmaintained two-unit investment property located in Buffalo's Riverside neighborhood. This 6-bedroom, 2- bathroom multifamily home features one tenant-occupied apartment that generates immediate rental income, while the second unit is vacant and ready for a new tenant or owner-occupant. Upper apartment has big 3/4 bedrooms, big living room/dining room, good size kitchen with full bath. Attached to the building is a commercial space well suited for an office, small retail shop, studio, or other business use, creating additional income or owner-use potential. Conveniently located near schools, parks, restaurants, grocery stores, places of worship, public transportation, and everyday amenities. An excellent opportunity for investors or business owners seeking flexibility in a prime neighborhood location. Also listed as a commercial property (B1720027) and available as a package deal with 366 Ontario St. listed together as a commercial listing (B1720045). Tax information is deemed reliable but not guaranteed.
